# active-border (tests/run.sh's config turns it on): a border round the
# focused pane of a split, following focus; none for a pane alone or one
# zoomed to fill its tab.
wait:0.5
expect-active-border:no
action:new_split:right
wait:0.8
expect-active-border:yes
action:goto_split:previous
wait:0.5
expect-active-border:yes
action:toggle_split_zoom
wait:0.5
expect-active-border:no
action:toggle_split_zoom
wait:0.5
expect-active-border:yes
shot:active-border.png
